note: Purim Katan: In a Jewish leap year, there are two months called Adar. Purim is celebrated in the second Adar. But on the 14th day of the first Adar, there is a small joyful day called Purim Katan, which means “Little Purim.” It is not the full Purim celebration, but it is still a happy day when people do not fast or give sad speeches.
